item.title: Houston ISD board votes to close 12 schools, angering audience at meeting
item.description: Houston ISD’s state-appointed board voted unanimously to close 12 schools, prompting backlash from parents and officials who criticized the lack of community input. District leaders cited declining enrollment and aging facilities as the reason for the closures. item.title: Virginia lawmakers propose guardrails for artificial intelligence use in education
item.description: As Virginia schools adopt AI and students spend more time on screens, state lawmakers question the technology’s impact on students’ safety, critical thinking and learning skills. item.title: School districts can set aside prayer time under a new Texas law. Few have done so
item.description: Most Texas school districts have declined a new state-approved opportunity to set aside time each day for students and staff to pray before school. So far, only 15 districts have opted into the voluntary prayer period, while many urban, suburban and rural districts have voted against it. The post School districts can set aside prayer time under a new Texas law. Few have done so appeared first on District Administration.

item.title: Study finds screen time negatively correlates with child vocabulary
item.description: In a survey of over 460 caregivers of children ages 17-30 months about word use and video consumption, Southern Methodist University found that spending less time with digital media was linked to higher vocabulary scores. The post Study finds screen time negatively correlates with child vocabulary appeared first on District Administration.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks California law against schools outing transgender students to parents
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared the way for California schools to tell religious parents if their children identify as transgender without getting the student's approval, granting an emergency appeal from a conservative legal group. item.title: Schools are using AI counselors to track students’ mental health. Is it safe?
item.description: Some schools are turning to AI chat platforms that flag student messages for potential self-harm or other safety risks. Experts say the tools may help short-staffed districts triage concerns, but warn they can’t replace human judgment and raise privacy concerns. item.title: NTSB says Waymo robotaxis illegally passed stopped school buses in new incidents
item.description: The National Transportation Safety Board is investigating a new incident of Waymo self-driving vehicles passing a stopped school bus with its ‌lights activated. In one case, a remote assistance operator reportedly misidentified the bus before the vehicle proceeded. item.description: The amended bill no longer has provisions to allow public schools to charge tuition or disenroll students without legal immigration status. The post GOP bill would require Tennessee public schools to check student immigration status appeared first on District Administration.

item.title: Families turn to states for civil rights support as Trump dismantles the Education Department
item.description: One of the Education Department’s biggest jobs is to police discrimination in America’s schools. But amid mass firings and shifting priorities, that role has waned. In its place, there’s an emerging push for states to step up. item.title: After more than 100 years, tiny N.J. town will shut down its only school
item.description: During a brief public meeting, the Ocean Gate Board of Education unanimously approved a five-year, renewable agreement with the Berkeley Township School District that will allow Ocean Gate students to attend Berkeley schools beginning next fall.
